sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 4 Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 4 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 4 OF 2002
APPOINTMENT OF
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
((An order to
amend the appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999)
No.2‑14/99‑Min.I,
dated 25‑2‑2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief
Executive's Order No.7 of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic 'Republic of
Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1)
This Order may be called the Appointment of Federal Ministers and Oath of
Office (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

of 1999."‑‑In the Appointment of Federal Ministers and
Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief Executive's Order No.7 of 1999), in the
Schedule, in the third paragraph for the words, commas and figure "issued
by the Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee, Chief of Army Staff and the
Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan on the Fourteenth day of
October; 1999 and all subsequent Orders issued by him the words "and all
subsequent Orders made or issued by the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan" shall be substituted.
